name: elea
description: Elea design system by Alien6 Studio: design tokens, headless core, block content viewer and editor for React

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/tokens && npm run build -w packages/content && npm run build -w packages/content-viewer && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/media && npm run build -w packages/content-editor
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/tokens && npm run lint -w packages/content && npm run lint -w packages/content-viewer && npm run lint -w packages/media && npm run lint -w packages/ui && npm run lint -w packages/content-editor
scripts.test:dtcg: npm ci --prefix docs/examples/dtcg --ignore-scripts && npm test --prefix docs/examples/dtcg
scripts.pack: npm pack -w packages/tokens -w packages/content -w packages/content-viewer -w packages/media -w packages/content-editor -w packages/ui --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.check: npm run build && node docs/examples/theme-shapes.mjs && npm run test:dtcg && npm run check:size && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:package --
